title: routing_next_hop doc lists routing_has_path as a caller, but this diff reroutes routing_has_path to routing_equal_cost_hops
location: core/routing.odin | routing_next_hop doc comment + routing_has_path body
evidence:
+// routing_next_hop — the FIRST (representative) equal-cost next hop at
+// `from_node` toward `dst_node`. A convenience over routing_equal_cost_hops for
+// callers that want a single deterministic hop (tests, routing_has_path). For a
 routing_has_path :: proc(r: ^Routing_Table, t: ^Topology, from_node, dst_node: u32) -> bool {
-	_, _, ok := routing_next_hop(r, t, from_node, dst_node)
-	return ok
+	_, count, ok := routing_equal_cost_hops(r, t, from_node, dst_node)
+	return ok && count > 0
 }
detail: The new routing_next_hop comment names routing_has_path among its callers, but the same diff rewrites routing_has_path to call routing_equal_cost_hops directly. The caller list is stale/misleading.
recommended_fix: Drop 'routing_has_path' from the comment's caller list (only tests call routing_next_hop now), or restore routing_has_path to delegate through routing_next_hop.
